name: Dark Activity / Smuggling
description: Vessel transponder deactivated inside restricted maritime security perimeter

name: Suspicious Loitering
description: Vessel loitering or stationary near designated critical infrastructure or high-risk grid

name: Illegal Fishing
description: Slow speed (<5 kts) maneuvering inside marine conservation or restricted zone

name: Border Intrusion
description: Course trajectory diverging towards International Maritime Boundary Line

name: Anomalous Behavior
description: Sudden extreme velocity variation exceeding operational threshold while near high-risk area
